name: [CH] Endpoint Apps - Unauthorized - Browsers [Is]
description: Intent: [CH] Cyberhaven-curated Unauthorized browser app names (exact match [is]) — chrome.exe, firefox.exe, safari, brave, opera, vivaldi, etc. Drives the Unauthorized-browser sub-segmentation on M5070 under the M5000 umbrella for non-sanctioned browser detection. Curated baseline. Exclusions: do not remove curated entries; use with care — every browser in this list is flagged at the endpoint, so if your org sanctions Brave or Vivaldi, gate the warn/block with user-conditions rather than trimming the list.
